description: Environment setup and baseline. Confirm Node/npm via nvm, dependencies present, and that the baseline builds/tests are green BEFORE making CSP changes, so any later failure is attributable to this change. This is required because CSP/hydration regressions only surface at build/runtime.
steps: Load nvm: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; confirm `node -v` is 22.x and `npm -v` works.
If node_modules is missing, run `npm install`. It is already present per routing, so likely a no-op.
Run `npm run typecheck` and confirm 0 errors on the untouched branch (baseline).
Run `npx vitest run tests/unit/proxy.test.ts tests/unit/security-hardening.test.ts` and confirm they pass (baseline).
Do NOT run a full build yet (saved for the verification feature) unless you want a baseline; a baseline build is optional given ~5min cost.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck` exits 0 on the unmodified branch
findings: Baseline verified GREEN on branch fix/1070-nonce-based-csp before any CSP changes. Environment: after sourcing nvm (export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"), node -v = v22.23.2, npm -v = 11.4.2. node_modules already present, no npm install needed. `npm run typecheck` (npx tsc --noEmit --pretty) exited 0 with no errors. `npx vitest run tests/unit/proxy.test.ts tests/unit/security-hardening.test.ts` passed: 2 test files, 19 tests (proxy.test.ts 12 tests, security-hardening.test.ts 7 tests), ~310ms. vitest v4.1.11. Did NOT run a full `npm run build` (optional, ~5min, deferred to the verification feature). Working tree clean aside from the untracked .agents task dir. Any typecheck/vitest failure in later CSP features is therefore attributable to those changes, not pre-existing state.
